content.description: The world’s premier decentralised blockchain interoperability solution. Wanchain’s cross-chain infrastructure empowers developers to build the future of Web3. Our mission is to drive blockchain adoption through interoperability by building fully decentralised bridges that connect the world’s many siloed blockchain networks. This cross-chain infrastructure empowers developers to build truly decentralised cross-chain applications to power the future of Web3. Wanchain drives blockchain adoption through crosschain interoperability by building fully decentralised direct bridges that connect the world’s many siloed blockchain networks.
